privileged_info_for_vlm: The target study is 'DM-TRIAL-2024'. The Subject Group Class must be named 'Treatment Arm' with type 'Arm'. There must be exactly three groups: 1) 'Metformin 500mg' (Description: Active treatment arm receiving metformin 500mg twice daily), 2) 'Metformin 1000mg' (Description: Active treatment arm receiving metformin 1000mg twice daily), and 3) 'Placebo' (Description: Placebo control arm receiving matching placebo twice daily). Verify that the 'Arm' type is selected, as this is a specific ID in the database.
